PurestSaturation.what: An experimental soft clipper: a sine-style curve built so gain steps stay lossless.
PurestSaturation.sound: More dynamic than an ordinary soft clip, with a distinct tone from the deliberately 'wrong' maths.
PurestSaturation.use: Soft saturation on tracks or a mix when you want something different from plain sine or tanh clipping.

SquareRoot.what: Soft saturation that never flat-tops: square-root shaping with controllable crossover distortion.
SquareRoot.sound: Quiet details come up louder, like a big push-pull tube amp or grungy organ. Gives a 'there in the room' feel to spiky drums.
SquareRoot.use: Retro tones, simulating acoustic loudness, and colouring amps and organs. Be careful with Soar.

controls.In: Drive into the square-root shaper. Up to about 12 dB of gain.
controls.Soar: Adds crossover distortion (Class B/AB style). Too much ruins the sound.
controls.Out: Level after the effect. Turn it down when driving hard.

Hypersoft.what: A soft clipper whose sharp corner sits in the quieter part of the wave, not at the top.
Hypersoft.sound: Grungy, colourful dirt that stays dynamic: subtly punchy to aggressively gnarly. Heightens impact rather than raw loudness.
Hypersoft.use: Drums and basses. Intensifying and adding impact, not for simple loudenating.

controls.Depth: How many extra wavefoldings are applied. More is more focused and colourful, and costs CPU.
controls.Bright: Higher allows all wavefoldings even when they alias, for more treble hype. Lower is darker.

Longhand.what: An experimental soft clipper working a sine out the long way round.
Longhand.sound: The purest, most continuous soft saturation, even softer than a normal sin().
Longhand.use: Ultra-soft clipping. Dry/Wet blends towards a softer clip.

controls.Dry/Wet: Not true dry: it blends a clip that lowers its threshold as it goes. Any dry makes the clip softer.

Creature.what: A soft slew saturator: up to 32 stacked slew wavefolders.
Creature.sound: Roars. Behaves like a filter and a distortion but is neither. The gain and thunder grow as Depth rises. No EQ, overdrive or highpass.
Creature.use: Monstrous overdrive with huge bass, or drum rooms. Be careful, it gets hard to control.

controls.Drive: Input gain into the slew stages.
controls.Depth: Number of stacked stages. More is bigger and louder.
controls.Inv/Wet: Inverted gives a highpass-ish cancellation; in phase, wet gives a monstrous overdrive with huge bass.

Huge.what: A dirty loudenator that adds odd harmonics and cuts any that would alias.
Huge.sound: Stupid loud, extra bassy, and very dirty and gritty.
Huge.use: Aggressive, loud material. Clean sounds will get a rude shock.

controls.Huge: Input trim and boost. Roughly unity at about 0.2.
controls.Nasty: How close harmonics are allowed to get to aliasing. Subtle; about 0.2 seems good.

NCSeventeen.what: A 'dirty loud' maximizer built around a soft clipper.
NCSeventeen.sound: A slight grunge, then it stretches to fit rather than breaking up. Keeps deep bass thanks to a second-harmonic feed.
NCSeventeen.use: Loudness and glue on drum submixes, synths and EDM, where other loudenators show artefacts.

controls.LOUDER: How hard you push it. It just gets dirtier the more you add.

Tube2.what: Tube with more sophisticated processing, input trim and a safe 0 dB ceiling.
Tube2.sound: Big and saturated, with extra harmonics. More Tube means softer, more saturated distortion.
Tube2.use: A final tubey safety clipper. Near level-matched with Input at 0.5. Feed it from Tube for more gain.

controls.Tube: Amount of tube character. Lower is more linear.

Tube.what: A simple tube-style 'soundbetterizer' that makes anything bigger.
Tube.sound: Very simple distortion with makeup gain: huge, lush midrange, with minimal processing.
Tube.use: Dropping anywhere (track, mix or mastering) to make it bigger. Keep it restrained or crank it.

controls.TUBE: Amount of tube saturation. Zero is a clean soft clip; full crank is heavy distortion with makeup gain.

Spiral2.what: Spiral with drive, highpass, output and dry/wet controls, plus Presence.
Spiral2.sound: Smooth sine-based saturation. Presence lets onset transients through, so full Presence sounds distorted while peaks still pass.
Spiral2.use: Fattening with clean transients. At Presence 0 it is exactly the original Spiral.

controls.Highpass: Filters the saturated part so bass stays clean.
controls.Presence: Crossfades in onset-transient pass-through. Halfway sits near 0 dB peaks.

PurestDrive.what: A subtle, pure saturation: the 'French House' drive.
PurestDrive.sound: Sine saturation blended with the dry signal by the previous sample, so it stays clean and textured, not a coat of paint.
PurestDrive.use: Subtle tone and texture all over a mix.

Focus.what: Distortion applied to a midrange band only, to bring out clarity.
Focus.sound: Aggressive but subtle. Lows and highs stay clean while the mids are distorted. Five distortion flavours in one.
Focus.use: Tracks, submixes or the 2-buss. At low Focus it is a broad overdrive; at high Focus a laser-focused mid distortion.

controls.Focus: Narrows the distorted band and lets more lows and highs pass untouched.
controls.Mode: Distortion type: Density, Drive, Spiral, Mojo or Dyno.
controls.Output: Level of the distorted band. Lower it to hear the clean lows and highs.

Mojo.what: A 'biggenator' and loudenator: an evolution of Spiral.
Mojo.sound: Concentrated huge. Fattens even with no boost and soaks up gain without an EQ change. Not clean.
Mojo.use: Thickening and loudening bass, drums or mixes.

Dyno.what: Like Mojo, but for intensity instead of loudness.
Dyno.sound: Adds fire and intensity and reshapes the waveform. Little volume boost, subtler than Mojo.
Dyno.use: Adding energy and bite where Mojo would be too fat. Similar in spirit to Remap.

UnBox.what: A distortion where only the harmonics that won't alias are allowed to distort.
UnBox.sound: A texture thickener with an analog quality. The mids are distorted while dry highs and a hint of bass pass through clear.
UnBox.use: Adding energy and thickness without oversampling or aliasing.

controls.UnBox: How much of the distortion is subtracted from the dry signal, opening up the clean highs.

Desk4.what: Distinctive analog coloration, a tuneable version of the Desk plugins.
Desk4.sound: Soft, textured, rich dirt, plus a brightness conditioner and a power-supply sag effect.
Desk4.use: Analog colour on channels and buses. Extreme settings are for deliberate grunge.

controls.Hi Choke: Treble choke. Subtle use conditions brightness; too much produces artefacts and DC.
controls.Frequency: Where the sag acts. Lower is tube-supply sag; tiny values hit higher frequencies.

Righteous4.what: A final output stage that clips, saturates and dithers to hit a loudness target.
Righteous4.sound: ADClip peak clipping, Spiral saturation and second-harmonic warmth. Big and open until you push past the target, then it breaks up.
Righteous4.use: Last in the chain: pick a loudness target (streaming or loud), listen for big and open, and output at your bit depth.

controls.LTarget: Your loudness (LUFS) target. Higher cleans it up and lets you push harder.
controls.BtDepth: Output bit depth, for example 16, 24 or 32 bit.
